items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and concats the result of the given AggregationExpression to it.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的字符串表示形式与给定AggregationExpression的结果进行拼接。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and concats given value to it.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的字符串表示形式与给定值进行拼接。

items.source: Concat the value resulting from the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 拼接由给定AggregationExpression生成的值。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and concats the value of the referenced field to it.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的字符串表示形式与引用字段的值进行拼接。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Concat the value of the given field.
Uses of StringOperators.Concat in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: StringOperators.Concat 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 包中的用途
